result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and written certification of deletion. However, it exceeds the playbook by covering all Confidential Information and materials rather than Customer Data. It also applies these obligations upon termination of any single Statement of Work, which could require return and deletion of all Company data even while the Agreement or other Statements of Work remain active. Those expansions are unnecessary and may disrupt ongoing services or legitimate retention obligations. Drafting is generally clear but should limit the trigger and scope to data associated with the terminated services and address legally required or backup retention.
